rationale.conceptual: Standard DFT with hybrid functional, but involves careful structure generation, strain application, work function extraction, and linking to water splitting redox potentials; several non-trivial interacting components.
rationale.execution: Pipeline includes constructing structures, PBE relaxation, generating strained configurations, HSE06 calculations for 63 states, and compiling CSV results. Many compute-intensive stages with dependencies and result handoffs.

difficulty.reasoning: Reproducing DFT bandgaps and band edges under strain requires a multi-stage workflow with many hybrid functional (HSE06) computations. The method itself is well-established but demands careful handling of structural models, strain series, and absolute potential references. The execution burden is high due to the large number of expensive electronic structure calculations across three structures and multiple strain points.

compute_estimate.reasoning: 63 HSE06 hybrid functional DFT runs on small monolayer unit cells; each run requires moderate memory but can be executed on CPUs; total CPU time is substantial.
